test_title: SSC CPO 2024 Official Paper-I (Held On: 27 Jun, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Which of the following is the characteristics of epilimnion?

options.text: Top-most layer in a thermally stratified lake

solution:
The correct answer is __**Top-most layer in a thermally stratified lake**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Top-most layer in a thermally stratified lake** is known as the epilimnion.
 
• The epilimnion is the upper layer of water in a stratified lake, characterized by warmer temperatures and higher levels of dissolved oxygen compared to the deeper layers.
 
• This layer is typically well-mixed due to wind action and receives abundant sunlight
